summary: Hansjakob Seiler was a linguist who studied under Manu Leumann around 1940 to 1947. He held a post at the University of Cologne from around 1959 to 1986.

Hanung Kim specializes in Tibetology and history and archaeology. Kim earned a master's degree from Columbia University and a Doctor of Philosophy from Harvard University under the supervision of Leonard van der Kuijp.

Har Bilas Sarda worked in history, archaeology, and Indology. He studied at the University of Calcutta from around 1884 to 1888 and served as a judge at the Court of Small Causes, Ajmer, around 1923–1924.
Har Dayal was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at the University of Delhi from around 1900 to 1903 and at SOAS University of London from around 1927 to 1930.

Har Dutt Sharma was an Indologist who completed his doctorate under Moriz Winternitz. He served as Reader in Sanskrit at the University of Delhi and held a post at Hindu College, Delhi (attested in 1957).

Hara Prasad Sastri worked in Indology, Buddhist studies, and history and archaeology. He served as Principal of Sanskrit College and University (attested 1905) and as Joint Philological Secretary of The Asiatic Society (attested 1905–1911).

Harabhatta Sastri was an Indologist who held posts at the Research and Archaeological Department, Jammu and Kashmir, serving as a pandit as attested in 1918, and further attested there in 1922 and 1945.
Harabhatha Shastri was an Indologist who served at the Research and Archaeological Department, Jammu and Kashmir, attested in 1911 and as a Pandit in 1916.

Harald Christian Rasmussen was an Indologist who studied at the University of Copenhagen under Michael Viggo Fausbøll, earning a kand.theol. and a Ph.D. He taught and served as Skoleinspektør at De forenede Kirkeskoler between 1875 and 1889.

Harald Hauptmann worked in archaeology and Iranian/Central Asian studies. He studied at Tübingen, Saarland, Heidelberg, and FU Berlin. His posts included Erster Direktor at the Heidelberg Academy of Sciences and Humanities and at the German Archaeological Institute at Istanbul.

Harald Hundius was a scholar of Buddhist studies and linguistics who studied under Singkha Wannasai around 1971. He served as a lecturer at Chiang Mai University in 1983 and as a professor at the University of Passau from around 1992 to 2004.
Harald Wiese works in Indology and other fields. He completed his habilitation at the University of Leipzig, where he was appointed professor in 1994.

Haraprasad Shastri was an Indologist and historian educated at Presidency University and Sanskrit College. He served as Principal of Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, department head at Presidency University and University of Dhaka, and president of Bangiya Sahitya Parishad.
Hari Damodar Velankar was an Indologist who studied under Hari Mahadev Bhadkamkar. He served as Professor of Sanskrit at Wilson College, Mumbai, and as Joint Director of Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan.

Hari Pratap Kailash works in philosophy and Indology. He earned an MBBS from the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, an MA from Jawaharlal Nehru University, and a PhD from the University of Delhi.
Hari Shankar Prasad is a scholar in philosophy, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He studied at Banaras Hindu University and studied under Ramakant Tripathi as well as Jan Willem de Jong.

Haridas Bhattacharyya was a scholar of philosophy and religious studies who studied at Scottish Church College and the University of Calcutta. He held teaching posts at both alma maters, the University of Dhaka, and Banaras Hindu University.
Harikrishna Sharma K. N. works in Indology and philosophy. He held posts as an assistant professor at V.T.B. College from 2011 to 2012 and at Sree Sankara College in 2012.

Harish Chandra Gupta studied at Government College Sanjauli. Working in Indology and Tibetology, he held posts at the National Library of India, Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, Globus Engineering College, Oriental College of Technology, and Shri Venkateshwara University.
Harish Chandra Mani Tripathi is an Indologist who studied under Karunapati Tripathi. He served as Publication Officer at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, attested in 1996.
